title: HotspotEvaluation
description: The evaluation of the counted hotspots of the project: the ranked classes with the two figures the join holds, the history the analysis rests on and the limits of the join

reasoning.description: Overall reasoning: what the counted hotspots show, and what the join of the change count and the complexity cannot see

history.title: HotspotHistory
history.description: The counted history the analysis rests on, and the named case in which it is absent

available.description: True when the counted history of the project was read, false when it is absent

window.description: The counted window of the history the change count was counted in, empty when the history is absent

truncated.description: True when the counted history is truncated, so that the classes changed before the counted window are left out

absence.description: The named case in which the counted history is absent, empty when the history was counted

reason.description: Why the counted history is absent, empty when the history was counted

statement.description: The statement of the history the analysis rests on: the counted window, and the truncation when the history is truncated

hotspots.description: One entry per ranked class, empty when the counted history of the project is absent

className.description: The qualified name of the class

modules.description: The modules whose reports contain the class, one entry per module; a class of an aggregator module and of its inner modules is reported once with all of them

items.description: The name of a module only, never a text, never a tool output

rank.description: The rank of the class among the classes of this project that changed, 1 being the class that comes first

changeCount.description: The number of commits that changed the file the class was declared in

complexity.description: The counted cyclomatic complexity of the methods of the class

methodCount.description: The number of methods of the class

reasoning.description: Why the class was read as a hotspot, with its two figures

limits.description: The limits of the join, one entry per limit: the counted window as the bound of the change frequency, the change count of the file of a class, the classes a truncated history leaves out, and the absence of ownership and of the age of the code
